title: Dance halls and joining the Quality Serenaders
summary: After the 401 and Danceland he replaced trombonist Taylor in a band working the Cotton Club, his start in cabaret work.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Uh-huh. What was your next job after the 401? That was pretty steady there for awhile, right?

Yes, it was steady. I think it lasted the latter part of '27. Then I begin to hop around. I went to another dance hall called Danceland, which was down the street, and around August or so, I was invited to join a band called The Quality Serenaders.

It was a band that at that time was working out of the Cotton Club which was the biggest night club in the West. And oneof their members was sick and he had to move back to Chicago. And he happened to be a trombone player.
Taylor was his name. And so I took his place. And that was the beginning of the big time cabaret sessions.
